The foundation

A program of Glappy Foundation

AfroBot is a kids-only youth robotics and AI program of Glappy Foundation, a Texas nonprofit corporation. Glappy Foundation is separate from Glappy Inc. Children take part through a parent or guardian.

Where it began

Cameroon, then McKinney

The work started in Cameroon in November 2022 and has run for about 4 years. A pilot in McKinney, Texas, followed in 2024.

We give children with limited access the tools, mentors and confidence to build the future with robotics and AI.AfroBot’s mission

The record so far

About 5,000 children have been trained through our holiday programs in Cameroon.

About 3,200 pupils aged 8–15 are in EDUCARE School Bamenda's primary and secondary schools. The partnership has run since June 2023.

Holiday totals: AfroBot records, November 2026. EDUCARE school reach: signed partnership letter, November 2026.

Access for every child

Robotics and AI should not depend on a family’s income or zip code. Team fees stay low, and sponsors and donors cover the rest. Kits and mentors are provided through partner schools. The focus is communities with fewer STEM opportunities in the US and Africa, and girls and boys are equally welcome.
